description: This file defines the ToDoView class, a GWT composite widget implementing the ToDoPresenter.View interface for the TodoMVC application. It manages UI components such as task list, routing links, counters, and handlers for user interactions.

classes.name: ToDoView
classes.description: A GWT composite widget that visualizes and manages the To-Do list interface for the application. It handles UI component initialization, user interactions, and communicates events to the presenter.

methods.name: getTaskText
methods.description: Returns the current text entered in the task input box.

methods.name: addhandler
methods.description: Registers event handlers for user actions such as marking all tasks complete, adding a task, and clearing completed tasks.

methods.name: setDataProvider
methods.description: Associates a data provider with the task list display.

methods.name: clearTaskText
methods.description: Clears the input field for new tasks.

methods.name: setTaskStatistics
methods.description: Updates UI elements to show total tasks, completed tasks, remaining tasks count, and checkboxes, based on current data.

methods.name: setRouting
methods.description: Updates the routing links in the UI to reflect the current view state (All, Active, Completed).
